reviews.review: I recommend this game. I know it's been out for a while, it's a big blast. Remember to stay frosty.
Easily the best FPS Aliens game ever made, and second only to Aliens: Dark Descent in gameplay and story.
The game is much better now

Good enough game if you like non-stop action, but it lacks enemy variety, location variety and overall variety of encounters. There are 4 chapters, every one them has 3 levels. And every single level goes by the formula: A bit of walking, a bigger arena for hundreds of enemies to spawn, a little bit of walking, another arena to kill several waves of enemies... you do that 3-4 times and the level is complete. 

The combat itself is quite fun, well, once you upgrade your weapons a little bit. I liked the second chapter the most, the others were pretty much similar to each other.

Second to last level bugged out for me 2 times in a row. I got stuck there into an infinite loop of 4-5 aliens spawning every 20 seconds or so. Had to redo that level 2 more times before it actually worked ~45 minutes wasted basically.

There is no horror in this game at all. FoV is terrible. You have to download a mod to make it more bearable and not feel claustrophobic and dizzy.

AI teammates always obstruct your line of sight, at least you can shoot through them on standard difficulty. Your character model is a bit too big for my taste, takes up about half of the screen when you aim.

if you want to max out your weapon upgrades, character's upgrade slots and so on - you'll have to replay same levels many times. Why it's so grindy - I don't know. You can get a bit of exp boost while using challenge cards (if you are lucky to get them), but it shouldn't be like this. 

NPC models have no facial animations while talking, only voice-over. Overall design of this game feels more like early 2010s. it's a good and a bad thing. But anyway, it was fun enough to not toss it away after a few levels. Definitely not worth the full price.
Overall a fun game. My wife enjoys it as well.
